messages:
michelle: Draft for changelog (v1.4.2) ready. Primary asks: - 3 short bullets for features, - one migration note (config rename: batching.enabled -> batch.enabled), - Python SDK snippet showing streaming responses, - callout for known issue where embeddings streaming returns truncated tokens. PTL review plz. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

ashwin: Looks good. Suggest change "migration" wording to "breaking config rename" — add example diff. Also add a short "what to do" line.

laura: I'm worried about the SDK snippet: streaming API changed last week; old snippet uses `stream=True` which is deprecated. Can someone paste recommended code? Also we should link to the migration guide.

sam: snippet (python):
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model="rwd-1.2", messages=messages):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Note: `chat.stream` supports iterating chunks now.

ashwin: small nit: "print(..., end=\"\")" could mask newlines in examples, maybe show assembling a result var instead.

michelle: Good catch. Update to assembly pattern and add a Go snippet too.

sam: go snippet:
```
client := redwood.NewClient(nil)
stream, err := client.ChatStream(ctx, redwood.ChatParams{Model:"rwd-1.2", Messages:msgs})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for stream.Next() {
    fmt.Print(stream.Text())
}
```
Will add inline to PR.

docs-bot: PR #842 updated by sam — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842/files

laura: Also discovered a link rot: /docs/embeddings/streaming -> returns 404 in staging. Can someone run the internal linkcheck before publish?

ashwin: I'll run linkcheck on staging and report back. Also will run the migration smoke test for config rename.

michelle: Can we add a "Known issues" note: Embeddings streaming may truncate last chunk for very long inputs on v1.2 runtime; workaround: set max_seq_length explicitly. Anyone confirm wording?

sam: confirmed on staging: set max_seq_length to 4096 reduces truncation. I'll add the workaround.

laura: +1 for explicit workaround. Also add a release note item "Docs: example updated for streaming API" and "Fix: link redirects".

michelle: Final ask: keep bullets minimal (<=2 lines each). I'll merge after small edits — target publish tomorrow 11:00 PT. :rocket:

ashwin: running smoke tests now — will post results.

docs-bot: smoke-test for changelog run by ashwin — success — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5555

michelle: Thanks all! merging in 15m unless any objections. :thumbsup:

sam: no objections. :thumbsup:

laura: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
